title: Moesha
description:

Crenshaw High’s basketball team is one game away from the city finals.

title: Moesha
description:
S2 E18 — Back To Africa
Moesha may have to bow out of the class trip to Africa when Frank invests all of the Mitchell savings in a Saturn dealership.

S3 E22 — The New Neighbors
The tenants are thrilled when Rose hires a live-in handyman for some much needed repairs, only to find he's handier with the violin than the toolbox.

S3 E23 — The Big Deal
Mary has a terrible time trying to be polite to Fox, who is rude and obnoxious yet potentially important to Lester's financial future.

S3 E24 — The Butler Did It
When Mary and Rose win the services of a butler in the church raffle, they look forward to the pampered life until they meet the pain-in-the-neck hired help.

S2 E1 — The Handwriting On The Wall
Mary, Rose and Pearl may be sent 'up the river' after they go overboard defending '227' against a graffiti artist who then sues them for assault--and it seems even bleaker when the key to their defense is the testimony of a lone eyewitness--Sandra.

title: Malcolm & Eddie

A chance to fill in on an all-night music show has Malcolm exhausted.

title: Malcolm & Eddie

description:

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E8 — Jealousy
Invited to dinner at the Sanford home, Fred's fiancée Donna brings along a patient who is in her care. Fred is shocked when the man, apparently a healthy specimen, makes it obvious he thinks of Donna as more than a nurse.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E9 — Tooth Or Consequences
When Fred's attempt to have a hypnotist cure his toothache fails, Lamont insists his 'chicken' father go to the free clinic. Resigned to his fate, Fred goes with Lamont, but it's Lamont who is in for the unexpected medical complication.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

George jumps at the chance of getting a street kid to work for him at half price, but finds it's costing him more than he bargained for.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E5 — George's Legacy
If Napoleon and Lincoln could do it, so can George Jefferson -- at least that's what George believes.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E6 — Good News, Bad News
An introduction to a friend puts Helen and Louise's friendship on the line -- and George couldn't be happier.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E7 — The Visitors
George and Louise are caught in the line of fire when Florence's battling parents pay the Jefferson household an unexpected and unnerving visit.

title: The Jeffersons
description:

George may be over his head when he introduces his young clerk Marcus to 'roughing it.'.
